استقطعت (form X)

# اِسْتَقْطَعْتَ (istaqṭaʕta) /is.taq.tˤaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# اِسْتَقْطَعْتِ (istaqṭaʕti) /is.taq.tˤaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# اِسْتَقْطَعَتْ (istaqṭaʕat) /i
